# Format: https://llmstxt.org

## Platform Name
Skill–Job Gap (https://www.skilljobgap.com/)

## What Is It?
Skill–Job Gap is a cloud-based career readiness and skills assessment platform. It measures a user's professional skills against real employer benchmarks, identifies critical skill gaps, and generates a personalized AI-powered learning roadmap.

## Core Purpose
Help job seekers, students, and career changers understand exactly where their skills fall short of employer expectations — and provide a clear, prioritized plan to close those gaps.

## Key Features
- Skill Gap Analysis: Quantitative measurement of proficiency versus target employer benchmarks across role-relevant skills.
- Employability Score: A weighted composite score (0–100) across Technical, Projects, Resume, Practical, and Interview dimensions.
- AI Learning Roadmap: Personalized, sequenced skill development plan based on identified gaps and difficulty/weight prioritization.
- Resume Analyzer: AI-powered resume scoring and improvement suggestions aligned to target role requirements.
- Interview Preparation: Role-specific interview question practice with gap-aligned focus areas.
- Peer Benchmarking: Percentile ranking against other candidates in the same role cohort.
- Verified Skill Certification: Shareable readiness report and verified badge upon assessment completion.

## Target Users
- Recent graduates entering the workforce
- Career changers switching industries or roles
- Professionals upskilling for promotion or new opportunities
- Employers assessing candidate readiness against internal benchmarks

## Scoring Methodology
The employability score is a weighted composite:
- Technical accuracy: measures domain knowledge and problem-solving
- Project completion: practical proof of applied skills
- Resume quality: relevance and clarity of professional presentation
- Practical competency: applied task performance under time pressure
- Interview readiness: structured communication and response quality
Benchmarks are updated quarterly based on top employer hiring criteria.

## Business Model
Free to start. Full assessment and gap analysis available without payment.

## Technology
Cloud-based SaaS. Accessible from any modern web browser. No installation required.
